display.purpose: Hero moments only: one per surface (page title, pass face).

body.purpose: Default reading size; cap prose at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase overline; the only uppercase in the system.

numeric.purpose: Tabular figures ('tnum') for times, capacities, amounts, codes.

motion.name: motion-standard
motion.purpose: The single easing/duration token for every state transition and reveal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Encre pill with white label; the one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-block-size: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; background: #141512; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #141512; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent pill bounded by a currentColor hairline; secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-block-size: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #141512; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.15; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field on bone with a hairline; the one non-pill control family.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Rechercher un membre" aria-label="Rechercher un membre" />
components.css: .ds-input { min-block-size: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; background: #ffffff; color: #141512; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 21, 18, 0.18); border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(20, 21, 18, 0.45); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 0.25rem; border-color: currentColor; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: The signature tracked-uppercase overline that introduces a section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #141512; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill: 18% tint of the status color under its dark text stop; label always present.
components.css: .ds-badge-succes, .ds-badge-erreur { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-badge-succes { background: rgba(37, 122, 78, 0.18); color: #1d5c3c; } .ds-badge-erreur { background: rgba(178, 58, 42, 0.18); color: #8f2f22; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: 0.62-opacity resting nav; active goes 800-weight with the 2px rounded underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; min-block-size: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #141512; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; opacity: 0.62; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0.25rem; height: 0.125rem; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; content: ''; }

components.name: Panneau imprégné (forêt)
components.description: The drenched identity panel: eyebrow + display statement on a full forest surface. One per screen, maximum.
components.css: .ds-panel-foret { padding: 1.5rem; background: #244f3c; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 1.25rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-foret__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-panel-foret__title { margin: 0; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.05em; }

narrative.overview: One brand from the public landing to the front desk to the member's pocket. The system is a documentary of real places: warm bone paper, near-black ink, and the flat colors of the venues themselves (forest, clay, ochre, sage, eucalyptus, water). Nothing shines that isn't real: a recorded product decision prohibits gradients outright; all depth comes from photography, flat color, typography, and contrast. Type does the heavy lifting: a single family (Inter Variable) speaking at documentary volume through weight (650/750/800) and scale. The landing shouts; the apps speak: tempered adoption reserves display scale for hero moments while working screens hold front-desk density. The forest/clay duality is meaningful, not decorative: forest belongs to the consumer/member side, clay to the partner/operator side.
keyCharacteristics: Bone paper, ink controls: warm #f2eee5 ground, near-black #141512 as the single control fill; white panels sit on bone.
Two drenched hues with assigned meaning: forêt (member/consumer), argile (partner/owner). Rare, deliberate, full-bleed when used.
One family, heavy hand: Inter Variable only; hierarchy through weight (400 → 650 → 750 → 800) and scale, never through a second font.
The eyebrow: a 0.75rem, 750-weight, 0.14em-tracked uppercase overline is the system's signature label, and the only sanctioned uppercase.
Flat, hairline-bounded: zero shadows; 1px currentColor-mix hairlines; pills for controls, 1.25rem panels for surfaces.
Numerals are tabular: every time, capacity, amount, and code renders in Inter with 'tnum' at weight 650.
French-first, sentence case, operational; 2.75rem minimum touch targets; 3px currentColor focus outlines.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Encre is the only control color. If a screen needs a second brand color on a button, the design is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Two Places Rule
rules.body: Forêt and argile are places, not paint: forêt = member side, argile = operator side. They appear drenched (a full surface) or not at all; never as borders, icons, or text accents.

rules.name: The Documentary Color Rule
rules.body: Color states a fact: whose side a surface belongs to, what category a thing is, what status it holds. Decorative color, and every gradient, is prohibited (recorded decision E-008).

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter Variable is the entire typographic system. A second font is a bug.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase exists only as the tracked 0.75rem eyebrow. Headings, buttons, and body are French sentence case, always.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any value someone compares, counts, or reads back renders with tabular figures at weight 650. No exceptions.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is prohibited. If a boundary needs asserting, use the hairline; if a layer needs separating, use a surface step or scrim.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border is 1px and derived from currentColor, so it recolors correctly on bone, white, forêt, and argile without new tokens.

dos: Do ground every screen in os (#f2eee5) with encre (#141512) ink; panels are blanc, hairlines are 18% currentColor mixes.
Do reserve forêt for member-side identity and argile for operator-side identity, always drenched, at most one per screen.
Do use the eyebrow (0.75rem, 750, 0.14em, uppercase) to introduce sections, and Inter's odd weights (650/750/800) exactly.
Do render every time, capacity, amount, and code with 'tnum' tabular figures at weight 650.
Do keep every touch target at 2.75rem minimum, the 3px currentColor focus outline visible, and prefers-reduced-motion honored with the single 360ms ease-out motion token.
Do give every list a designed empty state with one CTA, every region a skeleton matching its final layout, and every error a calm message with a support reference.
donts: Don't use gradients, ever: a recorded product decision prohibits them; depth comes from photography, flat color, typography, and contrast.
Don't use box-shadow, glassmorphism, or blur-as-decoration: the system is flat (see The No-Shadow Rule).
Don't build the "generic SaaS dashboard" PRODUCT.md forbids: no cream-and-blurple, no hero-metric cards, no identical icon+heading grids.
Don't drift toward the "loud consumer fitness app" (neon, gamified badges, hype copy) or "playful/gamified" (mascots, confetti, emoji).
compress into the "dense enterprise admin": reading text stays at 1rem, dense tables and rows may use 0.875rem and never less, rows breathe with hairlines, screens survive a 375px phone.
Don't go "cold corporate minimalism": no pure-white grounds, no cool greys, no timid 400-weight headings; the studio is warm and inked.
Don't uppercase anything except the eyebrow, use a second font family, put forêt/argile on borders/icons/text, or use border-left/border-right thicker than 1px as a colored stripe.
